file_assets_verified.name: file_assets_verified
file_assets_verified.value: "file_assets"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("file_assets"."media_type" IS NOT NULL AND "file_assets"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL AND "file_assets"."sha256" IS NOT NULL)

file_holds_temporary.name: file_holds_temporary
file_holds_temporary.value: "file_holds"."source_kind" NOT IN ('read','export') OR "file_holds"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

graphs_personal_identity.name: graphs_personal_identity
graphs_personal_identity.value: ("graphs"."owner_kind" = 'person' AND "graphs"."owner_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "graphs"."id" = "graphs"."owner_ref") OR "graphs"."owner_kind" = 'organization'
